data.title: Madinah Buses Launches Automated Response Service
data.content:
Madinah, November 18, 2026, SPA -- The Madinah Region Development Authority, represented by the Madinah Buses project, in cooperation with a specialized technology solutions company, has launched an automated response service to answer beneficiaries' inquiries and provide easy access to information about bus services.
    The service aims to enhance the Madinah Buses user experience and make information readily available through digital communication channels, improving service efficiency for residents and visitors of Madinah.
    -- SPA
